Definition: from G4253 and G191; to hear already,i.e. anticipate:--hear before.
BiblicalUsage: Proakouo means to hear before, to have heard already. Paul tells the Colossians of the hope laid up for them in heaven, whereof ye heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that hope is heard before it is seen, and the gospel heard long ago still holds the hope today.
